entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Brother of Moses and first High Priest of Israel. Served as Moses' spokesman before Pharaoh, oversaw construction of the Tabernacle worship system, and founded the Aaronic/Levitical priesthood that governed Israelite worship for centuries.
